{{Top|leg}}
'''Ube-tel''' was the name of the ritual hunt, which was used to train initiates of [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based tradition [[Keetael]].

The Ube-tel had no set schedule. These hunts lasted for weeks, with one or more Keetael Masters leading up to a dozen initiates on ancient trails through the brutal wilderness of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draethos (planet)|Draethos]]. Early hunts focused on discovering the inherent abilities of the Keetael initiates, while later hunts increasingly focused on controlling abilities and learning how to use them efficiently.
